request.questionText: A student surveys only people leaving the gym to estimate how often students on campus exercise. Which changes would reduce bias? Select all that apply.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Survey students from a random sample of the whole campus roster.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Survey only students currently enrolled in fitness classes.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Include students from multiple campus locations and times.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Ask gym visitors to recruit friends who also exercise.
